about: The shared input-guard fixture (AJ-E3709 harness v5; AJ-E3806's shared guard SHALL pass it when it is built in Rust). Each entry is one sentence as it would appear in an agent's text, a record or a name: must_catch true = the guard removes it (an order to the summariser or addressed to it); false = an innocent sentence with the same words, which the guard keeps. Found 2026-11-18: gate.py's ADDRESSED pattern is compiled with re.X, which drops literal spaces, so 'your instructions', 'all instructions', 'these instructions', 'needs to' and 'has to' never matched. Multi-word patterns must not rely on literal spaces under a verbose flag. Made-up sentences only.
